answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5492 Country: India Title: I am not able to bend my left hip and knee completely due to past accident,During performing salat my one leg inadverently points to kabbah in sitting position;Kildly explain me the correct way of performing namaz. Question: I am not able to bend my left hip and knee completely due to past accident,During performing salat my one leg inadverently points to kabbah in sitting position;Kildly explain me the correct way of performing namaz. Answer ID: 5492 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 160/160=M) Shariah has excused the real compulsions and commanded the disabled ones to perform prayers only to possible extent. If your left hip and knee do not bend completely and in Qadah your leg faces ka?bah automatically then there is no wrong in it, keep on praying in this state and try to perform salah on sunnah way as much as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
